limits: Real isolated SQLite, memberships, DAL, actions and audit. Authentication, Next cache and receipt removal are mocked; no real file or provider.
Three deterministic changes between read and conditional write are covered; this is not a hosted concurrency/load benchmark or a universal relational constraint.
PostgreSQL and browser execution require the new candidate CI. The current hosted Owner walkthrough does not qualify these role-specific cases.

publication.limit: Rule-based source/history scan; not a universal guarantee of absence of secrets.
